mapper.select: insert into _news(news_subject, news_content, news_place, news_startdate, news_enddate, news_resion, news_src, news_ins, news_att) values(#{news_subject}, #{news_content}, #{news_place}, #{news_startdate}, #{news_enddate}, #{news_resion}, #{news_src}, #{news_ins}, #{news_att})
select * from _news order by news_enddate desc
select * from _news where news_enddate > CURDATE() order by news_enddate
select * from _news where news_enddate < CURDATE() order by news_enddate desc
select * from _news where news_resion = #{news_resion} and news_enddate > CURDATE() order by news_enddate
select * from _news where news_resion = #{news_resion} and news_enddate < CURDATE() order by news_enddate desc
select * from _news where news_startdate between CURDATE() and CURDATE() + INTERVAL 30 DAY order by news_startdate asc limit 1
select * from _news where news_enddate > CURDATE() order by news_enddate desc
select * from _news where news_startdate between CURDATE() and CURDATE() + INTERVAL 30 DAY order by news_startdate asc
select * from _news where news_resion = (select SUBSTRING_INDEX(road_address, ' ', 1) as resion from _member where member_id = #{member_id} and news_enddate > CURDATE())
